meta.title: Pure Roots
meta.description: Lab-verified, farm-traced cold-pressed mustard oil. Scan any bottle and check the proof yourself.

home.headline: Every bottle tells you exactly where it came from.
home.heroKicker: Live lab proof on every bottle
home.heroInputHint: No login. Farmer + NABL lab report in under 10 seconds.
home.ticker1: Bottle PR-114-0832 verified · Jaipur · just now
home.ticker3: Pending status checked for PR-116 · Lucknow
home.subhead: Lab-verified mustard oil from single-origin farms. No blending, no secrets — just purity you can verify yourself.
home.statParams: FSSAI purity parameters tested per batch
home.statGuarantee: Refund if any batch ever fails
home.pillarLabBody: Every batch is tested at an NABL-accredited lab. RI, AITC, argemone, acid value — published, not promised.
home.pillarFarmBody: Scan your bottle to see exactly which farm your seeds were grown on — and the family who harvested them.
home.pillarSealBody: Test any bottle at a lab of your choice. If it fails, we refund 10× the price — publicly.
home.farmerQuote: We have been growing mustard since my grandfather's time. Pure Roots ensures our family gets a fair price for the extra care we take during harvest.
home.priceTitle: Purity isn't cheap. Here is why.
home.priceBody: Most market oils are blended to hit a price point. We price on the real cost of verified quality.
home.priceStep1Body: We only use the first cold press. Low yield, but every nutrient and the sharp pungency stay in.
home.priceStep2Body: We pay above market rate to named farmers who follow our pesticide-free protocols.
home.priceStep3Body: Every batch is tested at NABL-accredited labs. Transparency is a fixed cost we never cut.
home.verifyStripBody: Enter the batch or bottle code and see its lab record right now.
home.testWaterBody: Pure oil doesn't mix — it beads cleanly on top.
home.testFreezeBody: Pure mustard oil stays liquid; adulterants freeze first.
home.testPaperBody: A smudge that clears with warmth signals real oil.
home.testSmokeBody: Stable at high heat. Early smoke suggests blending.

verify.title: Verify any Pure Roots bottle.
verify.subtitle: Enter the batch or bottle code printed on the cap or under the seal to see its full lab certificate and farm origin.
verify.scanHint: Scan the QR code on your bottle instead
verify.hint: Try seed data: PR-114 or PR-114-0832
verify.faq1Q: Where do I find the code?
verify.faq1A: It's printed on the top of the bottle cap or on the label under the seal.
verify.faq2A: The batch is pressed but still undergoing final NABL lab clearance — it is not sellable until it passes.
verify.faq3Q: What if the code doesn't work?
verify.faq3A: Check you've entered it exactly as shown. A missing or invalid code may indicate an unverified source — contact us before using the oil.
verify.notFound: No record found for that code.
verify.notFoundBody: Check the code and try again. An unknown code may indicate an unverified source.
verify.error: Could not reach the verification service. Please try again shortly.
verify.bannerPassBody: Batch {batch} · Tested {date} · Passed all FSSAI purity parameters · Intact seal required for guarantee
verify.bannerPendingBody: This batch has been pressed but has not yet cleared lab testing. It is not sellable until it passes.
verify.bannerFailedBody: This batch failed lab testing and was never released for sale. If you hold a bottle from it, contact us immediately.
verify.labPendingNote: Lab results for this batch are pending. This page will show the full certificate the moment testing completes — we never sell before a pass.
verify.guaranteeBody: If any independent NABL-accredited lab finds this batch ({batch}) contains adulterants or fails the purity parameters above, we refund 10 times the purchase price — publicly. An intact seal is required.
verify.shareText: Pure Roots bottle {code} — lab-verified. Check the proof:
